graph_semantics.graph_edge: an adjacency between two road segments that meet at a junction
graph_semantics.graph_node: one road segment (link) of the Paris network
graph_semantics.pos_2: segment midpoint, stored but unused by the forward pass
graph_semantics.x_row: feature vector of one road segment
graph_semantics.y_row: Delta v for one road segment

isolated_note: The line-graph transform yields fewer graph nodes than stored feature rows, leaving a contiguous tail of segments with no incident edge. Their target is exactly zero in every scanned scenario.

provenance.metric_definition: Shape of the released training corpus.

target.name: policy-induced change in road-segment car volume
target.sign_convention: positive means more car volume under the policy than in the base case
